description_en: Retrieves a list of log projects
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem list-log-projects --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1733260000000 --log-user-id 1733260000000 --log-region-id cn-hangzhou --max-results 50 --next-token 'AAAAAUqcj6VO4E3ECWIrFczs****' --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListLogProjects

parameters.help_en:
The region where the data management center of threat analysis is located. Select the region of the management center based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Assets are located in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: Assets are located outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response message. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English.
Note: Although this parameter is marked as optional in the schema, the API returns a 400 error if it is not provided. Therefore, it is actually required. Valid values are zh (Chinese) and en (English)
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文。
注意：虽然此参数在schema中标记为可选，但未提供时API返回400错误，因此实际为必填项。取值为zh（中文）或en（英文）
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member accounts in the resource folder
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data ingestion user
parameters.name: log_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The log storage region ID.

This parameter is actually required. If it is not provided, the server cannot construct the log storage endpoint (it will be concatenated as null.log.aliyuncs.com), and the API returns a 400 fault
parameters.help_zh:
日志存储地域ID。

本参数实际为必填项，未提供时服务端无法构造日志存储 endpoint（会拼成 null.log.aliyuncs.com），接口返回 400 错误
parameters.name: log_region_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return in this request
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next query. If this is the first query or no subsequent query is required, leave this parameter empty. If a subsequent query is required, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries to return in this request
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next query. If this is the first query or no subsequent query is required, leave this parameter empty. If a subsequent query is required, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
NextToken.description_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
